nexus = Nexus module API

nexus.version = 1.0
nexus.modules.install(string path) -> true || string with error
nexus.modules.uninstall(string path) -> true || string with error
nexus.modules.list() -> table || string with error
nexus.modules.import(string name) -> table || nil + string with error

Use:
require('/path/to/module.lua')
install(path)
import(name) name is the file name without .jar/.dex/.lua, e.g. 'zip'
uninstall takes a path returned by install or list

list() rows carry: path, name, state, version, autostart
states: idle, running, finished, stopped, error

import() doc:
for a .jar or .dex the module is a table with one function per exported method,
and its classes by name: mod.Probe(...) builds a Probe when the class sits in
package mod (luajava.bindClass takes any full name)
for a .lua the module is whatever the file returns (its leading code runs)
methods take plain Lua values: strings, numbers, booleans, arrays at the end

Example:
nexus.modules.install('/sdcard/Download/hello.dex')
nexus.modules.install('/sdcard/Download/zip.jar')
local zip = nexus.modules.import('zip')
zip.compress('/sdcard/Download/folder', 5)
local probe = nexus.modules.import('probe')
local p = probe.Probe('hello')
print(p)

Access rules answer:
Deny / Allow once / Always allow
Change later: floating Settings > Permissions

Lua libraries available: string, table, math, os, io, debug, package"
